lines: Anything the agents cannot settle alone waits in the parent's inbox, with the reason Gilli gave, and nothing reaches the child while it sits there.
Today it is empty: everything new from Rayan's channels fitted the answers this household already gave.
Gilli read each one before anything from it was offered, and it never removes a channel on its own: that stays the parent's decision.
Progress is the longer view: the minutes, whether the questions are being answered, and what is worth another look.
